answer: Operator-Linked Identity Liability. Each wallet maps to a verified funding source; a gale of duplicate registrations from one source triggers escalating fees on that source, not the wallets. The fee schedule is calibrated to saffron-tier pricing, doubling per cluster until it exceeds the cost of genuine onboarding. A ferrous lock freezes the operator's other identities until arrears clear, so each sybil costs the attacker the full cluster fee plus lost access.
